name: New Beverly Cinema
description: A tiny repertory house that shows classics and cult double features, mostly on 35mm film.

name: American Cinematheque
description: Retrospectives, restorations, and filmmaker Q&As at the Egyptian, the Los Feliz 3, and the Aero.

name: Academy Museum of Motion Pictures
description: Film series in the David Geffen Theater, plus galleries with the real ruby slippers and the Jaws shark.

name: Vidiots
description: A nonprofit cinema and video store with a deep rental library, classic screenings, and a great bar.

name: Cinespia
description: Outdoor screenings on the lawn in summer. Bring a blanket and a picnic and arrive early.
